logp.method_description: LogDoct and logDtol were determined using a shake-flask procedure. A stock solution of the compound was prepared in n-octanol saturated with water 0.15 M KCl or toluene. 1 mL of solution was put in a separate vial to which 1 mL of buffer pH = 7.0 (ammonium acetate 10 mM) was added. All the buffers were ionic strength adjusted at 0.15 M KCl. The vial was vortexed for 10 min and the two phases were separated and analyzed by HPLC.
